features.quote: Cap iterations at 8, but allow early termination on success or surrender.
features.justification_quote: 8 × (5 models) × (6 tasks) = 240 max attempts. This is manageable computationally while providing statistical power.

features.justification_quote: If a model surrenders, continuing doesn't add information—it just adds noise.
